tagline: A collaboration of eight Local Government Pension Scheme funds pooling investments across Wales
hero_kpi_rationale: WPP has enabled the eight constituent authorities to pool approximately 75% of their assets since its establishment in 2017, generating significant cost savings and operational efficiencies.

kpis.name: Percentage of pooled assets
kpis.explanation: Percentage of constituent authorities' assets pooled through WPP
kpis.description: 75% of constituent authorities' assets have been pooled, enabling cost savings and improved investment efficiencies since establishment.
kpis.signal: Strong asset consolidation across Welsh LGPS funds

kpis.name: Constituent authorities
kpis.explanation: Number of LGPS funds participating in the pooling arrangement
kpis.description: WPP comprises eight constituent authorities representing all LGPS funds covering the whole of Wales.
kpis.signal: Full coverage of Welsh local government pension schemes

kpis.name: Investment sub-funds
kpis.explanation: Number of investment sub-funds offered through the pool
kpis.description: While no new sub-funds were launched in 2024/25, the Real Estate Investment programme is due to launch in 2025/26. Equity and Fixed Income manager days are held annually.
kpis.signal: Sub-fund expansion ongoing with Real Estate programme launching in 2025/26

kpis.name: ESG and sustainability recognition
kpis.explanation: Recognition for environmental, social and governance leadership
kpis.description: WPP won the ESG Innovation Award at the LGC Investment Awards in November 2024 for its Sustainable Active Equity Fund, the largest fund of its type in the UK. WPP retained FRC UK Stewardship Code signatory status for the fourth consecutive year.
kpis.signal: Industry recognition for sustainable investment leadership

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years. Metric tracked annually, with historical data over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 13.55 billion euros in the last year

kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 24.07 billion euros in the last year

kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 6.83 billion euros in the last year

kpis.name: Cash and equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of 2.69 billion euros in the last year

risks.title: Sub-funds fail to achieve target returns
risks.score_rationale: Presented as primary risk in the report, strong language ('most significant risk'), persistent risk with elevated score (>10), central category for business operations.

risks.title: Investment solutions inadequate to meet needs
risks.score_rationale: Identified as significant risk, concerned language ('fails to facilitate'), new regulatory pressure, high weight in business strategy.

risks.title: Divergence of opinion within the partnership
risks.score_rationale: Identified as major risk (score 15), alarming language ('cannot be reconciled'), upward trend, high impact on collective decision-making.

risks.title: Project Snowdon delivery delays
risks.score_rationale: New risk added in 2024/25, urgent language ('does not meet timescales'), high probability, critical impact on regulation and operations.

risks.title: Cyber security and data protection
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of threat ('cyber security breaches'), detailed response plan, elevated structural risk, although existing controls in place.

risks.title: Dependence on host authority for governance
risks.score_rationale: Central position of Carmarthenshire County Council, implicit language of dependence, systemic risk if disruption, high weight in operational structure.

risks.title: Shared governance and collegial decision-making
risks.score_rationale: Mention of democratic processes and consensus, measured language but acknowledgment of complexity, moderate but persistent risk.
